header.attach_route: cluster vocabulary = the attributes (lower-cased, whole) of the entries FILED in ATTRIBUTE_INDEX.by_cluster under each cluster; a preload's words ([a-z]+ tokens of: tier 1 lemmas + gloss; tier 2 name groups the shared name; tier 2 cluster groups the members' reach in that cluster; tier 3 the hypernym lemma; tier 4 the card's when + do) reach cluster C when a word equals an attribute of an entry filed under C; the attaches are those filed entries of C carrying that word. One word at a time, exact match, no stemming, never an intersection of raw names. No cluster reached -> no attach -> recorded, not usable (C2).
header.bond_route: tier 1 '≡' between a synset's own WordNet lemmas (two names, one referent); tier 2 '∥' between classes sharing a name, and between classes reaching the same cluster; tier 3 '∥' between a shared hypernym's distinct immediate children (grammar.json has no 'is a kind of' bond; a hypernym is the disjunction of its kinds); tier 4 the card's own binary operators as written in its do (grammar.json's binary operators only; ¬ is unary).
